scope: Static and local validation of deploy/terraform/aws, the cd-aws and terraform workflows, and the images they deploy. No AWS account was used: no plan, apply or AWS API call.

environment.docker: Docker Desktop, engine 29.8.0, 12 CPUs / 12.5 GB shared by four parallel agents
environment.java: Temurin/OpenJDK 21 via Maven 3.9 (host build of the JARs)

results.terraform_test_mutation_check: github_branch=develop makes the OIDC subject run fail as intended

keycloak_secure_cookies.without: no Secure; SameSite=Lax; non-secure context warning

results.otel_collector_config: collector started with the AOT_CONFIG_CONTENT pipeline (OTLP HTTP 127.0.0.1:4318 -> awsxray)

local_edge_end_to_end.ecs_health_check_command: passes in erp-core and edge-gateway images
local_edge_end_to_end.aws_smoke_sh: pass (health UP, issuer = public URL, unauthenticated 401, authenticated 404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND)

results.keycloak_first_start_ready_seconds: 15-23 on this host (six first starts in this session; time to the first UP from :9000/health/ready, 2 s polling)

labels.measured: all results above (local runs on the stated host)
labels.unknown: anything requiring an AWS account: plan/apply, IAM trust, ECS deployments, MSK/RDS/Valkey connectivity, CloudFront behavior, real cost
